reviews.text: If you are visiting Konkuk University, it is worth stopping by at least once. Although it is not a fancy or large museum, you can get a glimpse of when Konkuk University was first established and the traces and records of the people who founded and led Konkuk University. If you are interested in history, this will be a more interesting place. After visiting the museum, it is a good idea to look at the various sculptures and statues around. If you live near Konkuk University, it might be fun to take a walk around the lake and stop by if you have some time left. It would be interesting to find out what traces the museum's characters left in other areas of the school. If you do that, you'll see that it's not just a small museum.
